title: Tiepies Way More Ore's
description: This Project Adds Two New Main ores OrichalCium And Limunite and adds a new biome called ClearView and added 7 souls and added The Devils Smile and Blade (Needs Mcreator Link IF not working)
body:
THIS MOD IS BALANCED LIKE MY TIEPIE"S ORE"S MOD

This Is A Mod That adds Two More Ores That are Stronger Then Netherite 

**First Ore**
OriChalCium
A Strong Ore With The Best Armor IN the game|
Its Sword has a right click move but slow cooldown
Found IN ClearView Biome

**Second Ore**
Luminite
A Fast Ore But Less Damage has Better Tools Armor IS Decent
It's Sword Has Bleed Attack so like if you hit a player/Mob You make them Bleed for a bit
Found IN clearview Biome Mostly In Caves

Biomes
ClearView 
It is A All White And Black Biome That Represents A Cartoon World
Is The Main Biome to Find everything in the game

**_The Devil???_**
The Devil has Died and left Her Determination Blade IN the World But you need to restore Its Power By Finding All seven Souls and a wither rose
